messages:
alex_sales: Quick sync — HelixCare is moving toward a reserved commit but legal needs clarity on sizing and burst behavior before signing. Can ops + finance propose two clear options?

maya_sre: What presales numbers did they give? rps, avg tokens, model?

alex_sales: Presales used 42 rps peak, 30 rps steady, ~125 tokens avg. Model: redwood-gpt-3.2-q (quantized). They requested 99.9% availability and p95 < 450ms. Commitment in draft: 20M tokens/month.

ishaan_infra: Quick calc: peak token rate = 42*125 = 5250 tps -> ~453.6M tokens/day if sustained. 20M/month is far below peak. We should offer: (A) baseline reserve sized to steady (30 rps) + overage; (B) reserve sized for peak with burst-credit buffer.

dan_prod: Also flag KV-cache warmup for multi-turn chat. Recommend default preheat 5h; shorter preheat increases cold-miss probability and tail latency.

nora_fin: I will draft two price scenarios: steady-reserve (30 rps) and peak-reserve (42 rps). Include worked example for token overage and GPU-hour burst credits.

maya_sre: Autoscale snippet we can share:
```yaml
autoscaling_policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas_reserved: 12
  scale_step: 1
  cooldown_seconds: 45
  target_p95_ms: 450
  burst_pool: hosted-burst
```

ishaan_infra: Routing fallback to include in MSA: reserved -> quantized-2B fallback -> hosted-burst. I will produce an rps->GPU sizing table for A100/H100 tomorrow.

alex_sales: Customer asked: can they BYOK and restrict region?

ishaan_infra: Yes for Dedicated/Private. BYOK integration typically needs 48-72h lead time for key policy and handoff. Region restriction supported (us-east-1 / eu-west-1) for dedicated. Add to security answers.

maya_sre: Ops checklist for contract: KMS BYOK, VPC/private endpoint, audit log export, and escalation path for AZ-level evictions. Call out fallback latency bands.

deploy-bot: scheduled job "helixcare-smoke" for 2026-04-06T04:00:00Z. Participants: @ishaan_infra, @maya_sre.

nora_fin: I will include billing language: reserved monthly fee + token overage price + GPU-hour burst credit rate. Will show two-line-item examples.

dan_prod: Ill compile a one-page runbook (sizing matrix, autoscale YAML, routing fallback, KV warmup guidance, short security answers). Draft by EOD tomorrow.

alex_sales: Timeline: customer to confirm commit semantics today. Ishaan posts sizing table in 48h. Nora circulates pricing Monday. Maya to run smoke once NDA + traffic sample received. Thanks all :thumbsup:
